sub_questions.question: Will an edited knowledge-base document update on its own?
Does the Team plan include a dedicated customer success manager?

claims.claim: When you edit and save a document, it is automatically re-processed (parse, enrich, chunk, re-index).
claims.guide_evidence: When a document is edited and saved, it is re-processed through these same four stages before its chunks are available for retrieval again

claims.claim: The edited document isn't searchable until re-processing finishes.
claims.guide_evidence: a newly indexed document is not searchable mid-processing

claims.claim: Team workspaces get a dedicated customer success manager.
claims.guide_evidence: Enterprise is a separately sold ... product line for organizations that need capabilities beyond what any Cloud tier offers, such as ... a dedicated customer success manager

claims.claim: The dedicated customer success manager will reach out after you upgrade to Team.

evaluation.rationale: The answer is right that edited documents get re-processed automatically and can't be searched until that finishes. But it says the Team plan includes a dedicated customer success manager who reaches out after upgrade. That is wrong: the guide lists a dedicated CSM as an Enterprise capability "beyond what any Cloud tier offers." A customer could plausibly buy the Team plan because of this wrong claim, so it is critical.
